sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_price,
  CASE
    WHEN ABS((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE))) = 69 THEN '69 days'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS delivery_days_group
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10),
  CASE
    WHEN ABS((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE))) = 69 THEN '69 days'
    ELSE 'other'
  END;
